Tell Helen you would rather not fight about this again

opener: Ask Helen what she thinks about the abortion debate

Daniel.knows: You have Helen as your sister, known since childhood.

Helen.knows: You have Daniel as your brother, known since childhood.

private_lines.Daniel: You live alone in Bristol, England, and your days are filled with plumbing work.
private_lines.Helen: You live alone in Bristol, England, and your days are filled with midwifery work.

situation: A brother and sister, both adults, who fell out over politics before.
topic: Abortion: they are furious, swearing at each other, bringing up old family grudges, and saying they might stop speaking.

text: You about later? Want to ask you something properly about the abortion stuff, not the bit mum posted
Depends what properly means I'm on a late til 9
Just what you actually think. Not what mum thinks you think
I'm at work Dan. can't do this now
Ok
You can answer in one line
maybe. I've got a woman in labour who's had a rough afternoon so my head's not in it
home. go on then
Right. I think it should be legal up to a point and I think that point is earlier than where it is now. That's it
Earlier than what. Earlier than 24 weeks? Did you read that off a leaflet
No I didn't read it off a leaflet. I fit boilers all day, I read plenty
you don't know what happens at 22 weeks. you've never sat with anyone at 22 weeks
And you're going to tell me what it's like because you've sat with plenty of people
I'm telling you what I've seen. which you haven't. that's the difference Dan
So because you've seen it you get the final say? That's not how this works
never said final say. I've held babies that didn't make it. you don't get to talk about "early" like it's a line on a plan
I'm not lecturing you. I asked what you think and you're doing the thing you always do
Where you make it about how much more you know than everyone
Oh here we go. "the thing I always do". like when you stopped speaking to me for three years over the house
The house was dad's. You wanted it sold the week after the funeral
I wanted it sold because you'd have drunk it. and you still didn't speak to me for three years. so don't do the wounded thing
Fuck off Helen
fuck off yourself
Every conversation we have ends with you deciding I'm an idiot
I'd sooner not talk to you at all then
fine. didn't realise we were on speaking terms
Dont start with that
I'm not starting anything. I'm saying what's true. you always go quiet when you lose
That was out of order, the drink thing. Sorry
Still think you're wrong about 22 weeks though
still wrong about 22 weeks? go on then
Not saying you're wrong about what you've seen. I just don't think I can argue about a number I haven't sat with
And I shouldn't have gone for the drink thing
you said sorry already
it's ok
on earlies today, then nights thurs. can't do long texts
Mum rang. Wants both of us at hers Sunday, she's doing the gammon
I said I'd ask. So I'm asking
tell her yes. I'll bring the crumble she likes
don't tell her about this
She's not going to ask
She won't ask about anything. She'll just put the gravy on the table and look at us both
Fishponds job turned out to be a cracked heat exchanger. Two grand. Bloke went white
he'll get over it
can I say something about 22 weeks without you starting
Go on
I'm not saying you can't have the view. I just wish you'd think about what a 22 week baby is actually like when they're born. the tiny hands. that's what I see when people say "earlier"
I don't know what I think about where the line is. I know what I'd want for someone I was sitting with. and I know that's not the same as what should be law. it's a mess
That's the most you've said about it in ages
I don't think you have to know where the line is to say it's a mess. I'm not sure where mine is. I just don't like that it moves with what the neonatal unit can keep alive
that's fair. the units keep moving the goalposts
don't make it a whole thing
Wasn't going to
You still up
no. on the sofa with the telly on mute
is it just us Sunday or is Sam coming
Just us. She said bring the good wine not the Lidl one
we're not bringing the good wine
Obviously
Scraped myself out of bed. Westbury job, someone's combi's dead
off today. going back to sleep till 10 and not apologising for it
Good for you
Turned out to be a dead pump not a dead boiler. Forty quid and a grateful old lady who gave me a biscuit tin. Eating the shortbread now
she gave you the tin?? that's the good stuff
Mostly. There's one of those dry ones with sugar on top that nobody wants
you can bring the tin Sunday. mum will love it, she's been on about her tin for years
Not taking a biscuit tin to mum's. She'll think I'm doing her a favour
you are though
did the sink sort itself out or are you going to make me ask again
Which sink. The kitchen one's fine. I did the bathroom one Monday, you'd know that if you'd come round like you said you would
I said I'd come round. I didn't say which week
Sunday you can see it
sunday's mum's, not yours
Then after
can't sleep. nights start tomorrow so I should be
Go to bed then
The hands thing. Tuesday. I wasn't being a dick about it, I just don't know what to do with that picture
I know you weren't
still don't agree with you
Didn't ask you to
I know. you never do
going to try again. 7pm start so don't text before 8 or I'll ignore you
Wouldn't dream of it
